subject: Create a self-review skill that spawns multiple reviewers before PR creation
description:
Write a Claude Code skill (slash command) for self-reviewing code before creating a PR. It should:
- Diff the current branch against main
- Spawn multiple reviewer sub-agents (configurable via arg, e.g. `/self-review 3`)
- Each reviewer focuses on a different perspective (correctness, security, style/patterns)
- Aggregate findings into a summary
- Optionally proceed to PR creation after review passes
